# Select Photo

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Allows you to select a photo.

## Syntax

~~~~text
selectPhoto(types: <#Enumeration Array (Optional)#>, multiple: <#Boolean (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
selectPhoto(types: , multiple: )
~~~~
